info.name: Il Santo
info.plot: Dopo che la moglie entra in coma, Reinaldo, professore ateo, decide di porre fine alle sue sofferenze, ma proprio in quel momento, come per miracolo, lei si sveglia. La scena, a insaputa di Reinaldo, viene filmata. Samuel, pastore di una comunità, offre dei soldi al professore - sommerso dai debiti per le spese mediche - per fare dei sermoni nella sua chiesa, indirizzandolo su un improbabile cammino che poco a poco lo converte in un leader religioso.

episodes.name: Episodio 1
episodes.plot: Reinaldo's life is shaken when his wife is shot and goes into a vegetative state. Faced with a very high hospital bill and with no prospect of seeing his wife improve, Reinaldo opts for euthanasia. However, unexpectedly, she wakes up. Pastor Samuel believes that Reinaldo has performed a miracle, so he offers him money to preach to his congregation.

episodes.name: Episodio 2
episodes.plot: Reinaldo expects to return to his normal life, but the church and its parishioners aren’t done with Pastor Rei. Now, Paulo, a member of the church and the hospital nurse who filmed the "miracle", wants Reinaldo’s help to bring his mother, who is in a vegetative state, back to life. Reinaldo's daughter, meanwhile, begins to grow suspicious of what her father is up to.

episodes.name: Episodio 3
episodes.plot: Reinaldo finds himself living a double life after he accepts Samuel's offer to continue preaching in exchange for more money. Later, Reinaldo’s commitment to the community deepens when he meets a faithful parishioner who is a victim of domestic violence. Now, the moral leader of the church, Pastor Rei, must find a way to help the woman.

episodes.name: Episodio 4
episodes.plot: Reinaldo’s mother Eleonora, who has always believed her son was something of a saint, appears at church. For his part, Reinaldo has blocked out memories of his childhood. Later, Reinaldo faces a dilemma after his daughter finds out about his double life. Samuel’s brother Sinval returns from a stint in hell.

episodes.name: Episodio 5
episodes.plot: Gabriela pleads with her father to bring an end to his secret life, but while he feels guilty, he also realizes that he is actually helping people who are suffering. Later, Gabriela goes missing after being invited by Dinei to a party, and during the search Reinaldo confronts suppressed memories from his childhood.

episodes.name: Episodio 6
episodes.plot: Gabriela si trova ad affrontare una situazione terrificante in cui è costretta a drogarsi e difendersi da un attacco. Reinaldo e Dinei combattono in un confronto confusionario e fatale. Inoltre, Maria Clara è sempre più perseguitata da visioni mentre lotta senza vista, ma proprio quando la recupera, ricorda un ricordo inquietante del periodo in cui era in coma.

episodes.name: Episodio 7
episodes.plot: Reinaldo turns to Samuel after he is kicked out by Maria Clara and his daughter turns her back on him. Sonia and Reinaldo spend a special, almost sacred, night together. Just as Reinaldo begins to truly believe in his gift, he and his flock are dealt a shocking revelation from a fervent believer.

episodes.name: Episodio 8
episodes.plot: Reinaldo decides to accept the invitation to preach at Bishop Joyce’s church. Convinced of his gift, Reinaldo confronts a difficult truth — his father, Josias, reveals that his supposed miracles are merely illusions to block memories of a trauma he suffered as a child. As he faces a packed church, Reinaldo rises to pulpit intent on setting things straight.

translations.title: Damned Saint
translations.overview: Reinaldo's wife is in a vegetative state, bringing him to decide to euthanize her to end her suffering. However, as if by a miracle, she wakes up. Reinaldo did not know it, but he was being filmed at the time. Samuel, a failed pastor, offers Reinaldo — now drowning in medical debt — money to be a preacher, sending the atheist Reinaldo down a strange and unlikely path to become a religious leader.

A esposa de Reinaldo, um professor ateu, que estava em estado vegetativo, milagrosamente acorda. Reinaldo não sabia, mas estava sendo filmado e um pastor oferece todas as suas economias para que Reinaldo pregue aos seus fiéis. Endividado, ele se torna um líder religioso e passa a ser uma figura estranhamente complexa.
